top_signal.title: How do you get through the “people are interested but nobody is buying” stage of a new product business?
top_signal.summary: I launched a small handmade dog enrichment brand about two weeks ago and I’m struggling with the gap between people saying they love the product and people actually buying it.   I’ve had decent website traffic from Instagram/ads, but only a few sales and hardly any add-to-carts. I’ve compared my pricing to similar handmade products and don’t think I’m overpriced.   For anyone who built a physical product business from scratch, what actually helped you move from interest to consistent sales?   Was it reviews/UGC, better content, ads, wholesale, local marketing, or just time and repeated exposure?  I’m trying to figure out whether I need to keep building trust or whether I should be questioning the product itself.   If anyone wants to have a look and tell me what they think, the website is   pokitstudio.com         submitted by     /u/Comfortable_Skirt792       [link]       [comments]
